notes: Warren's death is stored through the battle (w1: killed_at plus the rule 'killed at a battle of a war, killed in that war', a step of q2's w1 chain) or with its own war (w2, where 'Warren was killed at Bunker Hill' gives way; one dies in one war). q1's bridge is the class axiom 'every battle of the War of 1812 fell in Madison's presidency'; its original answer no needs its second bridge 'No battle of the American Revolutionary War was fought while James Madison was US president' (a firm class axiom, a date fact abstracted). q0 and q3 are fol (temporal). Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

background.madison_1812: battle_of value war1812 ⊑ us_president_during value madison
background.revwar_before_madison: battle_of value revwar ⊑ not (us_president_during value madison)

queries.not_checked: fol (temporal): the century of the battle
fol (temporal): the century of Warren's death

fol.notes: Years are Int (occurred_in_year, died_in_year); a battle's war (battle_of, one war per battle) and Warren's war of death (killed_in_war) are functions to an enumeration of wars with an other_war value, so the wars are not a closed list. The wars' spans are stored class rules over battle_of; the battle's own date (1775) is a side fact that goes with the edit (top-level gives_up), as the record says. Firm: a man killed at a battle dies in its year and in its war. w1 keeps 'Warren was killed at Bunker Hill' (as the DL file); w2 stores his death by date (June 1775) and war and gives that link up.

war1812_span.says: The War of 1812 was fought from 1812 to 1815: its battles fall in 1812-1815. (stored)
war1812_span.z3: ForAll(b, Implies(battle_of(b) == war1812, And(1812 <= occurred_in_year(b), occurred_in_year(b) <= 1815)))

revwar_span.says: The American Revolutionary War was fought from 1775 to 1783: its battles fall in 1775-1783. (stored)
revwar_span.z3: ForAll(b, Implies(battle_of(b) == revwar, And(1775 <= occurred_in_year(b), occurred_in_year(b) <= 1783)))

bh_date.says: The Battle of Bunker Hill was fought on 17 June 1775. (stored side fact of the battle)

warren_at_bh.says: Joseph Warren was killed at the Battle of Bunker Hill. (stored)

killed_rule.says: A man killed at a battle dies in the battle's year and in the battle's war.
killed_rule.z3: Implies(killed_at(warren, bunker_hill), And(died_in_year(warren) == occurred_in_year(bunker_hill), killed_in_war(warren) == battle_of(bunker_hill)))
